_comment: EETRA MatLib — single source of truth for all visual settings (colors, typography, layout, catalogue, Streamlit theme). Edit here; Python loads via libs/lib_tokens.py and regenerates 02_html/_tokens.css and .streamlit/config.toml [theme] on change. RESTART REQUIRED for anything under "catalogue": those values are copied into module globals once, when libs/lib_ui is imported (init_catalogue_layout_globals), so a running server keeps the old ones. Editing this file does not trigger runOnSave either — that watches .py files. Stop and restart Streamlit to see catalogue changes.

brand._comment: One canonical product name. Used by the browser tab title, the masthead and every page header.
brand.tagline: Low-Carbon, Circular Materials for a Regenerative Future.

palette._comment: Role-named secondary palette. Every hex that used to be hard-coded in Python CSS strings (lib_header.fn005, ECOportal badges, Revalu page, catalogue card actions) now lives here and is substituted for var(--eetra-p-*) automatically by lib_tokens.css_hex_to_var().
palette._revalu_violet_comment: Sampled from Revalu brand CTA (Perform Early-Stage LCAs). Used for Add/Edit Revalu R-badge.

typography.font_sans: 'Miranda Sans', 'Source Sans Pro', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

layout._comment: Shared iframe heights. 'default' applies to any component without its own entry; keys match the names passed to lib_ui.fn359_iframe_height().
layout._cards_max_embedded_comment: Page size for the Catalogue 'Cards' view. Each card's image is base64-embedded into one iframe payload (~190 KB per product measured), so this is a payload budget, not a style choice: 60 cards is roughly 11 MB per rerun, and Streamlit's websocket limit is 200 MB. Raise only if you have measured the payload.

page_title._comment: Per-page titles (Catalogue, Charts, …). Use px (not rem) for font_size so Windows text-scaling / browser root font-size cannot shrink titles on some PCs. margin_top + scroll_margin_top keep titles clear of the sticky top nav when landing and when scrolling. Clearance under the bar on non-Welcome pages also uses chrome.shell.sticky_clearance. margin_bottom + first_block_gap set the shared title→content whitespace (Catalogue title → View/Grid/List/Size toolbar).
page_title._margin_bottom_comment: Title wrap bottom margin. 12px ≈ Catalogue title→toolbar (6px wrap + 6px #cat2-chrome padding-top) so Charts/Developer/etc. align without the iframe chrome.
page_title._first_block_gap_comment: Streamlit VerticalBlock gap between the title ElementContainer and the next sibling (content). Keep tiny so margin_bottom owns the visible whitespace.

layout._padding_top_comment: Whitespace above page body. Keep modest — sticky top-nav clearance is owned by chrome.shell.sticky_clearance + page_title.scroll_margin_top.
layout._horizontal_comment: block_container L/R = 0 so page body lines up with top-nav labels; main_padding_* is the shared inset from the sidebar/right edge.

sidebar._used_by: Sidebar width via st.set_page_config(initial_sidebar_state) in fn001; H-key toggle in sidebar_keyboard_shortcut_script. collapse_header + user_content_padding_top pull 'Signed in as' up toward the top-nav band.
sidebar._width_px_comment: Initial sidebar width (200–600). Streamlit handles collapse/expand natively — do not override with fixed CSS.

keyboard_shortcut._key_comment: Press this key (case-insensitive) to toggle sidebar visibility; ignored while typing in inputs

header_divider._comment: Full Welcome masthead chrome in fn001b_render_app_masthead(compact=False). show/show_above/show_below control the rule; margin_top = whitespace ABOVE the masthead; space_below = whitespace BELOW the divider. Compact bar for other pages: chrome.masthead_compact.

shell._comment: Revalu-style top nav: white fill + thin bottom rule. border_* = rule + whitespace above/below. sticky_clearance = space under sticky bar before page titles (non-Welcome). Sidebar stays light grey (paint_sidebar false).

masthead_compact._comment: PARKED — enabled:false so the compact green bar is not shown. Flip enabled to true to revive. Non-Welcome clearance now uses chrome.shell.sticky_clearance.

horizontal_divider._comment: App-wide in-content divider via render_horizontal_divider() / fn304_slim_divider(). Defaults apply unless overridden by kwargs or a named preset under presets.

add_edit_section_above_title._used_by: Add/Edit Identity + Details — full-width light-grey rule ABOVE all-caps section labels (Product Info URLs, Physical properties). Title colour matches this rule; margin_bottom keeps the label tight under it.

sidebar_collapsed_control._used_by: Streamlit sidebar expand/collapse chevron (1.59+: stExpandSidebarButton / stSidebarCollapseButton)

auth_gate._background_image_opacity_comment: Library-wall overlay on [data-testid=stMain]::after (0–1). Higher = stronger photo / less milky wash. Served from static/login/MatLib__login_bground.jpg when present.
auth_gate._logo_height_px_comment: Rect logo height on login masthead (px)
auth_gate._brand_spacing_comment: White space above logo/title block; gap before login card
auth_gate._title_margin_comment: Space between EETRA logo and Material Library title

picker_caption._used_by: Developer Dashboard · 'Viewing N / M items' line above the active-filters strip in the left rail

field_group_section._used_by: Add/Edit form · subheader above grouped fields. ``page_title_scale`` sizes ``section_title_style: page_title`` like ``chrome.page_title`` (Developer Dashboard title) at that fraction.

add_edit_form._used_by: Developer Dashboard → ➕ Add New Item & ✏️ Edit Existing Item (embedded pages/13_Add_Edit_Item.py). Controls vertical rhythm inside category tabs and between the edit picker row and those tabs.
add_edit_form._widget_row_gap_px_comment: Vertical gap between each horizontal field row inside Identity / Details / EPD / GWP / … tab panels (classic form). The default editor uses the same 30px in libs/item_editor/item_editor.css (--ie-row-gap).
add_edit_form._widget_columns_gap_px_comment: Passed to st.columns(..., gap=) as pixel int (Streamlit 1.60+). Horizontal spacing between widgets in Add/Edit field rows.
add_edit_form._edit_picker_to_tabs_gap_px_comment: Space below the Search + Select item to edit row and above the category tabs when editing a product.
add_edit_form._widget_font_comment: Single font family (typography.font_sans) + size for ALL Add/Edit tab content: labels, inputs, C/M, status, Revalu captions, section titles, summary. Scoped to the form block only (see add_edit_form_css) so it does not shrink the Developer content column.

left_nav._used_by: Developer Dashboard · vertical left-column section navigation (st.radio styled as a tab rail)
left_nav._section_gap_after_comment: Padding/margin under the horizontal divider after Edit Item and Edit Manufacturer in the left rail.
left_nav._section_divider_comment: Hairlines after Edit Item / Edit Manufacturer. Prefer 2px (not 1px): 1px borders often disappear under Windows display scaling (125%/150%).

keyboard_shortcut._key_comment: Double-press H within ~400ms (case-insensitive) to show/hide the left Nav Menu; ignored while typing in inputs. Avoids clashing with the sidebar single-H shortcut. default_visible: rail starts shown until the user hides it.
keyboard_shortcut._default_visible_comment: When true, the Developer left Nav Menu is visible until the user presses HH to hide it.

app_documentation._used_by: Developer Dashboard → App Documentation tab · APP_DOCUMENTATION.md rendered markdown

database_schema._used_by: Developer Dashboard → App Documentation → Database Schema tab · DATABASE_COLUMNS.md tables

catalogue._comment: Product catalogue layout & typography per UI surface. Loaded by libs/lib_ui_catalogues.py → CATALOGUE_* module globals → fn329 (Streamlit) / fn336 (JavaScript iframe).

page_controls._used_by: pages/2_Catalogue.py · Streamlit search / tag filter / display settings row above tabs
page_controls._comment: Set show false when the JS catalogue owns search and display (Cards tab).

streamlit._used_by: pages/2_Catalogue.py · Streamlit tab · fn329 native cards · lib_header .product-title / .product-details CSS

filter_bar._comment: In-iframe filter bar = view-local refinement only. 'hidden' removes dimensions the sidebar owns globally (prod = product type, mat = material type) so the same question is not asked twice with two different answers. Valid ids: search, prod, mat, country, prog, voc, fu, group, sort. Set scope_label to "" to hide the label.

typography._font_families_note: Sans → theme.typography.font_sans via 02_html/_tokens.css (--eetra-ff-sans). Serif GWP/rec values → theme.typography.font_serif (--eetra-ff-serif).
typography._base_font_size_used_by: body, toolbar, filters, list table root (--c-fs)
typography._modal_gwp_used_by: .modal-gwp-value — full GWP line in the right-hand detail panel ('GWP = 13.27 kgCO₂e/m²').

detail_panel._used_by: Right product detail panel (Info / Tech. Details / Sustainability / Documents) · catalogue_component_js2.html · --js2-detail-* CSS vars via js2_typography_root_css()
detail_panel._sus_label_column_used_by: .cat2-sus-row grid track 1 — field labels (GWP, thickness, …). Paired with sus_value_column as 38fr/62fr (38%/62%). A 1px vertical rule sits between the tracks.
detail_panel._sus_value_column_used_by: .cat2-sus-row grid track 3 — values (track 2 is the vertical rule). 62fr of the 38fr+62fr pair ≈ 62%.

card_name_divider._used_by: Horizontal rules above/below the product name (.cat2-name) in Cards view sizes M, L, XL · card_name_divider_root_css() · hidden entirely for size S.

grid._used_by: Streamlit catalogue grid height · JS2 iframe height baseline · row spacing between card groups

card_surface._used_by: Streamlit fn329 card min/max height · JS2 --cat-card-min-h / --cat-card-max-h

material_type_band._used_by: Material-type strip on card image · Streamlit fn329 + JS2 · --cat-mat-* CSS vars

image_band._cache_tiers_note: Two served sizes, both derived from the untouched originals in 01_data/img. Measured display sizes: grid cards top out at 98x94 CSS px, the detail panel at 180x130. Each tier is ~2x that, so it stays sharp on a HiDPI screen without shipping a 300px file for a 78px slot.

gwp_pill._used_by: GWP gradient pill under cards · Streamlit fn329 · JS2 --cat-gwp-pill-* vars · _GWP_LABEL_FONT_SIZE_PX

streamlit_page._used_by: Streamlit catalogue tab only · group headings (#####) spacing in pages/2_Catalogue.py CSS

charts._used_by: pages/3_Charts.py · Plotly / Altair / ECharts JS typography & axis labels (single source)
charts.font_family: Miranda Sans, Source Sans Pro, sans-serif
